ratchet_raptor_hides.accept_text: Sunscale screechers hunt the plain outside the west gate, thickest along the Southfury banks to the north. The lashtails are further off - the Raptor Grounds, down in the Southern Barrens. Either hide will do.

ratchet_thinning_the_grounds.accept_text: The lashtails keep to the Raptor Grounds - south through Camp Taurajo, on the east side of the Southern Barrens. Their screechers range as far north as the Southfury banks, but it's the lashtails I want thinned.
